results.title: Tinubu Demands Profitable Refineries
results.description: By Bero Damilola President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has assured petroleum workers that Nigeria’s refineries will return to operation, stressing that their revival must deliver value and profit to the country. Tinubu gave the assurance on Thursday, August 13, 2026, when he received the National Executive of the Nigerian Union of Petroleum and Natural Gas Workers [...] The post Tinubu Demands Profitable Refineries first appeared on QUICK NEWS AFRICA .
